description.text: The fourth expansion of the MEGA series, released on 13 March 2026. Mega Greninja ex leads it, a Mega Evolution first seen in Pokémon Legends: Z-A that does damage with both its Ability and its attacks: the Ability lets its player discard a basic Water Energy from the hand to put six damage counters on one of the opponent's Pokémon. Mega Floette ex joins it, with an attack that heals 30 damage from every Pokémon on both sides and another, Eternity Bloom, that does 200 damage and attaches Energy to its player's Benched Pokémon, and with the Stadium Ange Floette, put into play by discarding a Prism Tower already in play, which gives Mega Floette ex 150 more HP. The Stage 2 Pokémon Chesnaught and Delphox, Gourgeist ex, Cobalion ex, whose Ability moves any amount of Metal Energy from its player's Pokémon in play onto it when it comes into the Active Spot from the Bench, Mega Pyroar ex, Mega Dragalge ex, Beedrill ex and Cinccino ex join them, with the Supporter AZ's Tranquility and two Special Energy, Bubbly Water Energy and Magnetic Metal Energy. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 83, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Trainer cards, Special Art Rare cards, and Mega Greninja ex as a Mega Ultra Rare. In English most of its cards came out in Chaos Rising in May 2026.
